verdict.rationale: Docs confirm single-call card creation via /cards endpoint tied to user and card product, instant-issue virtual card language, and a sandbox environment with simulation endpoints for testing before going live. However, there is no explicit documentation confirming PAN/CVV/expiry are returned immediately in the create-card response, nor any description of a self-serve path from sandbox to live production without a sales/onboarding process. missing for 10: explicit API response showing PAN/CVV/expiry returned on card creation, evidence of self-serve production activation without sales engagement.
